nodes.name: Run backup

parameters.command: ={{ (() => { const value = $('Settings').first().json.rcloneConfigBase64; if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/.test(value) || !value.trim()) throw new Error('Set rcloneConfigBase64 in Settings before running.'); const config = value.replace(/\s/g, ''); return "RCLONE_CONFIG_CONTENT='" + config + "' /opt/scripts/vps-backup/vps-backup --run --config /root/.config/vps-backup/config.json"; })() }}

nodes.notes: Select the target VPS SSH credential. Adjust binary and config paths. Use the same Linux user that saved the settings; container stops need Docker access.

nodes.name: Telegram
nodes.notes: Add a Telegram bot credential and chat ID, then enable this node. Disable Discord or Telegram independently.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Paste your base64 rclone INI here after import, including union upstreams. Base64 is not encryption. This value and the resolved SSH command may be retained in n8n execution records. Never commit a filled export.
